label: Hospitalisation
summary: Pays hospital bills that the mutuality does not.

product.name: KBC Hospitalisation Insurance
product.pitch: Hospital cover with no age ceiling on renewal, for people the family plan does not include.

label: Family liability
summary: Covers damage you cause to other people, including by children and pets.

product.name: KBC Family Insurance
product.pitch: One policy for every person in the household, including adult children living at home or in a kot.

label: Home & fire
summary: Building and contents after fire, storm or water damage.

product.name: KBC Home Insurance – owner
product.pitch: Building and contents cover for a new home, with storm, water and theft options.

label: Car (BA + omnium)
summary: Third-party liability, plus own-damage cover on the car.

product.name: Car insurance – third-party liability (BA/RC)
product.pitch: Liability cover with an omnium level matched to the car's current value.

label: Fraud & cyber
summary: Refunds and help after phishing, fake calls and unauthorised payments.

product.name: KBC CyberSecure Insurance
product.pitch: Refund cover and a trusted-contact alert that also reaches the family member managing the account.

label: Travel
summary: Medical costs, cancellation and luggage when you are abroad.

product.name: KBC Travel Insurance
product.pitch: Covers a full exchange semester abroad, including medical costs and repatriation.

label: Legal aid
summary: Pays a lawyer in a dispute about your car, home or neighbours.

product.name: Car legal assistance
product.pitch: Legal costs for traffic, property and consumer disputes.

headline.gap: No legal help if it goes wrong

label: Student / kot contents
summary: Belongings and deposit risk in a rented room away from home.

product.name: Home contents insurance
product.pitch: Laptop, bike and room contents in a student room, plus damage to the landlord's property.

label: Mortgage protection
summary: Repays the mortgage if a borrower dies.

product.name: KBC Comfort Loan Balance Insurance
product.pitch: Offered together with the mortgage pre-approval so it is in place on the day of the deed.

label: Roadside assistance
summary: Tow, repair on the spot and a replacement car.

product.name: KBC-VAB vehicle assistance
product.pitch: Breakdown help for an ageing car, at home and abroad.

headline.gap: No help if the car breaks down

label: Care & dependency
summary: A monthly amount when you need daily help at home or in a care home.

product.name: Care & dependency cover (mock, not in the KBC list)
product.pitch: A fixed monthly allowance once home nursing or daily care is needed, in addition to the zorgbudget.

label: Income protection
summary: Replaces part of your income if you cannot work for a long time.

product.name: Work-disability cover on loan balance insurance
product.pitch: A monthly payout that keeps the mortgage and household costs paid during long illness.
